findings.label: User token spent on channel-capped guesses
findings.detail: allow_guess charges the per-user bucket before checking the per-channel bucket, so a guess blocked by the channel cap still costs the player a token. Check the channel bucket first or refund/peek the user bucket if it matters in practice.

findings.label: Silent channel cap in group hangman
findings.detail: At 5 acted-on guesses per 5 s per channel, letters from an active group hangman game are dropped with no feedback. Deliberate per plan decision 12; consider a one-time reaction per window or a looser RATELIMIT_CHANNEL default.
